newsitem.title: USA: Motorola to provide equipment to Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to provide equipment to Malaysia.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Monday its Multimedia Group will provide equipment to establish telephony communications systems in Malaysia.

Motorola will deliver an initial 10,000 CableComm cable telephony lines to Bina Sat-Com Sdn Bhd, a unit of Binariang Sdn Bhd, in the fourth quarter. Basic telephony service currently reaches just 15 percent of Malaysia's 20 million residents, said a Motorola official.
Financial terms of the supply pact were not announced.
Motorola manufactures communications equipment in addition to making semiconductors for personal computers.
